domain_name.description: Relative name of the domain serving the application. Example: example.com.
domain_name.security_impact: Controls which domain the App Engine app is exposed on. Misconfigured domains may expose internal services or unused endpoints to the internet.
domain_name.rationale: Restricting domain mappings to known, approved domains reduces the risk of subdomain hijacking and data exposure.
domain_name.compliant: domain_name = "secure-service.example.com" (points only to an approved production domain).
domain_name.non-compliant: domain_name = "*.example.com" (wildcard domain unintentionally exposes all subdomains).

ssl_settings.description: SSL configuration for this domain. If unconfigured, this domain will not serve with SSL. Structure is documented below.
ssl_settings.security_impact: Improper SSL configuration may allow plaintext (HTTP) traffic, exposing data in transit.
ssl_settings.rationale: Enforcing SSL ensures that all connections to the mapped domain are encrypted with TLS.
ssl_settings.non-compliant: ssl_settings { ssl_management_type = "MANUAL" } without certificate_id (domain will not serve with SSL).

certificate_id.description: ID of the AuthorizedCertificate resource configuring SSL for the application.
certificate_id.security_impact: Manual certificates may expire or be misconfigured, breaking TLS coverage.
certificate_id.rationale: Where manual management is used, certificate rotation must be automated.
certificate_id.compliant: certificate_id = "12345" with ssl_management_type = "MANUAL" and automated renewal in place.

ssl_management_type.description: SSL management type for this domain. AUTOMATIC provisions a managed cert, MANUAL requires certificate_id.
ssl_management_type.security_impact: Determines how TLS certs are provisioned. AUTOMATIC is more secure and lower-maintenance.
ssl_management_type.rationale: Prefer AUTOMATIC to reduce operational risk and ensure continuous TLS coverage.

pending_managed_certificate_id.description: (Output only) ID of the managed AuthorizedCertificate resource currently being provisioned.
pending_managed_certificate_id.security_impact: Read-only status attribute; no direct security impact.

override_strategy.description: Whether the domain creation should override any existing mappings for this domain. By default, overrides are rejected. Default value is `STRICT`. Possible values are: `STRICT`, `OVERRIDE`.
override_strategy.security_impact: Not applicable — this attribute cannot be validated using current helpers.
override_strategy.rationale: While override_strategy controls replacement behavior, it is not possible to enforce via policy helpers.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.security_impact: Relying on implicit project configuration can result in deploying to the wrong environment.
project.rationale: Always specify project explicitly for clarity and to prevent drift.
project.non-compliant: Project omitted, relying on provider default.
